house.description: Annual reporting on school resource officer contracts required.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Education Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; requiring annual reporting on school resource officer contracts; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 123B.02, subdivision 25.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 123B.02, subdivision 25, is amended to read:

Subd. 25.
School resource officers.
[+(a) +]A board that contracts for the services of a school resource officer must ensure the contract meets the requirements of section 626.8482.

[+(b) A board must submit an annual report to the commissioner of education, in the form and manner determined by the commissioner, that contains the following information about a contract for the services of a school resource officer: +]

[+(1) the law enforcement agency that provides the school resource officer; +]

[+(2) the start and end date of the contract; +]

[+(3) the number of school resource officers contracted for; and +]

[+(4) the school sites school resource officers are assigned to. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2025. +]
